g.text: Education and employment paths by AI exposure in Korea
Fixed upper and lower employment-weighted quintiles of 2025 AI exposure. Annual averages of April and October survey-weighted stocks.
The same occupational memberships apply to every degree. Lower panels show levels to make small postgraduate populations visible.
Educational attainment follows the retained manuscript proxy. All-age employed people, not new graduates or graduate employment rates.
